title: torch 2.9.0dev on cuda 13 producing Cuda mismatch error during flash/sage attention install
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

The RHEL system is on latest 580+ nvidia open driver with Cuda 13 (only!), Python 3.13.6
During attempts to install flash or sage attention it determined the torch version 2.9.0.dev20250810+cu129, but always failing with Cuda versions error. According to Ai assist its the problem of torch which can't yet compile for Cuda 13.0 and recommending to downgrade Cuda to 12.9. Is this correct & When Torch will support Cuda 13 finally?
